answer: Randomized Duty Relay. Each epoch, a public beacon draws a verifiable random seed; agents are assigned to a thin inlet of active work slots by hashing the seed with their identity, and only drawn agents may submit results, with assignment verified against the seed after reveal. Because the seed is unpredictable until the epoch opens, an attacker cannot precompute which identities will be needed, so must maintain every fake identity live and online like a reef of idle accounts, paying full compute and presence costs per identity. A mirror audit re-derives each assignment to catch duplicates.
